Destructive pattern detected: truncate -s/--size
Full command: truncate	-s0 logfile.txt
This command is permanently blocked. Safe route: there is no safe equivalent — truncate destroys file content in place. Back up the file first ('cp <file> <file>.bak') if you need to recover it, or find a non-destructive way to achieve the goal (e.g. rotate the log instead of truncating it). To allow this pattern, add a Bash permission rule to settings.json.
